evidence_type: aggregate label-support and boundary audit only; no model execution

rules.active_sample: finite appliance power strictly greater than 15 W
rules.complete_episode: qualifying active run with finite inactive samples before and after inside one block
rules.dependency_contained_complete_episode: complete episode with rise - 255 >= block_start and final active row + 8 < block_end
rules.missing_values: counted; break episode continuity; never backward-filled
rules.output_boundary: aggregate counts only; no sample values, target series, predictions, metrics, or figures
